# NEXUS CORE

> Free AI-built gold (XAUUSD) game plan: key zones, scenarios and the level that proves the view wrong, refreshed before the Asia, London and New York sessions, every plan graded in public.

NEXUS CORE AI publishes a free, AI-built trading plan for gold (XAUUSD) three times each trading day: before the Asia session (07:00 GMT+7), before London (13:45 GMT+7) and before New York (19:30 GMT+7). Each plan gives the bias, the main zone, targets, the level that invalidates the view, scenarios with rough probabilities, and the economic calendar. Every plan is graded in public on 15-minute candles after it expires: wins, losses and misses all stay on the record. Analysis only, not financial advice.

## Latest plan (2026-11-17, Pre-New York plan, updated 2026-11-17 19:38 GMT+7)

- Permanent page: https://nexuscore.trade/en/plan/2026-11-17-newyork/
- Bias: SELL
- Summary: Sell the rally into 3910⁠–⁠3932; The view is wrong on an H1 close above 3936; main zone 3982⁠–⁠4000.7
- Main zone: SELL 3982–4000.7
- Target T1: 3843.7
- Target T2: 3832.5
- Target T3: 3800
- Expected range: 3800–3936
- View is wrong if: The sell view fails on an H1 close above 3936, only 3949⁠–⁠3970 / 3982⁠–⁠4000.7 would remain above. The main zone is void on an M15 close above 4004. Early warning: an M15 close above 3901.4.
- Main scenario (~50%, SELL): Branch A: before the data price ranges 3853⁠–⁠3871 around the 3853.8 daily open. Hot Retail Sales (bad for gold) / an M15 close below 3841 → the 3841⁠–⁠3846 breakdown zone becomes active, targets 3832.5 → 3800.
- Alternate scenario (~50%, BUY): Branch B: soft Retail Sales / M15 closes above 3889 then 3901.4 → rebound into 3910⁠–⁠3932; a rejection there turns price back to 3887 / 3870; an H1 close above 3936 → the rebound extends into 3949⁠–⁠3970 / main zone 3982⁠–⁠4000.7. Direction after the data is set by the H4 close.
